'''''ACA 198: Omarov vs. Suleymanov 2''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event promoted by [[Absolute Championship Akhmat]] that took place on January 9, 2026, in [[Grozny]], Russia.

===Background===
A [[Absolute Championship Akhmat#Featherweight Championship|ACA Featherweight Championship]] rematch between current champion Islam Omarov and former champion Alikhan Suleymanov headlined the event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Карин |first=Никита |date=2025-12-04 |title=Титульный реванш Омарова и Сулейманова состоится 9 января на турнире ACA 198 |url=https://mma.metaratings.ru/news/titulnyi-revansh-omarova-i-suleimanova-sostoitsya-9-yanvarya-na-turnire-aca-198-556694/ |access-date=2025-12-06 |website=mma.metaratings.ru |language=ru}}</ref> They previously competed at [[2023 in Absolute Championship Akhmat#ACA 160: Slipenko vs. Gadzhidaudov|ACA 160]] in July 2023, where Omarov won the title via second round TKO.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-07-21 |title=АСА 160: Омаров и Гаджидаудов стали новыми чемпионами, все результаты турнира |url=https://www.championat.com/boxing/news-5179237-asa-160-omarov-i-gadzhidaudov-stali-novymi-chempionami-vse-rezultaty-turnira.html |access-date=2025-12-06 |website=Чемпионат |language=ru}}</ref>

An interim [[Absolute Championship Akhmat#Lighteight Championship|ACA Lightweight Championship]] bout between Daud Shaikhaev and Herdeson Batista served as the co-main event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-12-04 |title=Бой между Исламом Омаровым и Алиханом Сулеймановым возглавит АСА 198 в Грозном |url=https://matchtv.ru/edinoborstva/matchtvnews_NI2274721_Boj_mezhdu_Islamom_Omarovym_i_Alihanom_Sulejmanovym_vozglavit_ASA_198_v_Groznom |access-date=2025-12-06 |website=Матч ТВ |language=ru}}</ref>

===Bonus awards===
The following fighters received $20,000 bonus. The other finishes received $5,000 additional bonuses.
*'''Fight of the Night: Khalid Satuev ($50,000) vs. Nikolay Aleksakhin ($20,000)'''
*'''Performance of the Night: Islam Omarov''' and '''Sulim Batalov'''

'''''ACA 199: Frolov vs. Emeev''''' is an upcoming [[mixed martial arts]] event promoted by [[Absolute Championship Akhmat]] that will take place on January 16, 2026, in [[Krasnodar]], Russia.

===Background===
A lightweight bout between Alexey Polpudnikov and Rasul Magomedov was scheduled to headline the event.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Искендеров |first=Бахтияр |date=2025-12-02 |title=Полпудников и Магомедов проведут бой 16 января на турнире ACA 199 |url=https://mma.metaratings.ru/news/polpudnikov-i-magomedov-provedut-boi-16-yanvarya-na-turnire-aca-199-555960/ |access-date=2025-12-22 |website=mma.metaratings.ru |language=ru}}</ref> At the weigh-ins, Polpudnikov weighed in at 73,75 kg, 2,45 kg over the limit. As a results, the bout has been officially cancelled by ACA president [[Magomed Bibulatov]], citing Polpudnikov's serious violation of regulations during the weigh-in.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-16 |title=Полпудников сорвал взвешивание перед ACA 199: перевес почти 2,5 кг |url=https://sportify.press/fighting/aca-199-sryv-vzveshivaniya-pereves/ |access-date=2026-01-16 |website=Sportify.Press |language=ru}}</ref><ref name="ACA199">{{Cite web |date=2026-01-16 |title=Магомед Бибулатов сообщил о смене главного боя на ACA 199 |url=https://sportify.press/fighting/aca-199-smena-glavnogo-boya-frolov-emeev |access-date=2026-01-16 |website=Sportify.Press |language=ru}}</ref>

A middleweight bout between Artem Frolov and UFC veteran [[Ramazan Emeev]] was originally scheduled to headline the event, but the bout was shifted to the co-main event instead.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Искендеров |first=Бахтияр |date=2025-12-02 |title=Фролов и Эмеев проведут бой 16 января на турнире ACA 199 |url=https://mma.metaratings.ru/news/frolov-i-emeev-provedut-boi-16-yanvarya-na-turnire-aca-199-555706/ |access-date=2025-12-02 |website=mma.metaratings.ru |language=ru}}</ref> After the main event was cancelled, the bout was promoted to new headliner.<ref name="ACA199"/>
